major_concerns: Risk-scoring method unspecified — could systematically miss adversarial/novel faults.
Digital-twin / formal-checker construct validity not quantified (may not reflect production devices).
Latency SLO not numerically specified; feasibility depends on precise SLO choice.
Threshold selection, risk-calibration, and preregistered decision rules under-specified.
required_design_repairs: Specify numeric latency SLO(s) (e.g., 95th percentile target in ms) and justify chosen values.
Define the risk-scoring algorithm, features, calibration data, and preregistered thresholds and selection procedure.
Include adversarial / OOD test cases in sensitivity analysis to evaluate risk-scoring blind spots.
Document digital-twin fidelity limits, scope of protocols/vendors modeled, and how full-checker ground truth is produced and validated.
Predefine retry and failure-handling policies for provider outages and how such incidents are treated in latency/accuracy analyses.

major_concerns: Curated vendor-accurate dataset creation is nontrivial and may limit reproducibility and external validity.
Legal/ethical concerns around vendor-specific semantics — need to ensure publicly shareable synthetic equivalence.
Digital-twin verifier coverage may miss vendor-specific regressions; potential construct validity gap.
Baseline/template repair selection must be justified to avoid unfair comparison.
required_design_repairs: Specify dataset construction rules, data sources, and provide synthetic-but-shareable examples with generation scripts to ensure reproducibility.
Include legal/ethical clearance statement and avoid proprietary config artifacts; document how vendor semantics are modeled/validated.
Provide metrics of verifier coverage by vendor/protocol and include manual spot-checks or external validation of verifier labels.
Predefine deterministic baseline repair templates and justify their selection; include ablation showing sensitivity to baseline choice.
Preregister stopping criteria, max iterations, and random seeds; provide code/IR to reproduce mixed-effects model fitting and diagnostics.

major_concerns: Adversarial-prompt generation is dual-use; ethical safeguards and artifact-release restrictions required.
Formal validator coverage gaps could mislabel unsafe outputs, biasing detector performance estimates.
Detector methods and thresholds not enumerated — results will be hard to interpret without concrete detector specs.
Risk of overfitting detectors to synthetic adversarial examples; generalization concerns.
required_design_repairs: Define and preregister adversarial-generation methods, include ethical guardrails, limited artifact release policy, and red-team oversight.
List candidate detectors explicitly (algorithms, hyperparameters, thresholds) and preregister ensemble aggregation rule.
Quantify validator coverage and include uncertainty estimates; where validator gaps exist, include manual adjudication or conservative labeling policy.
Include held-out adversarial scenarios and cross-validation to measure overfitting; preregister dataset splits and random seeds.
Specify allowed dissemination level for adversarial prompts/outputs and justify with safety assessment.

major_concerns: Heavy reliance on simulated operators creates a large simulation-to-reality validity gap.
Calibration sources for simulated operator behavior are underspecified and may be nonrepresentative.
Causal claims about operator workload/trust from simulation could be misleading without human validation.
Risk of overclaiming utility of explanation augmentation when human subjects not involved.
required_design_repairs: Fully specify simulated-operator model: data sources, parameter estimates, distributional forms, and calibration procedure; preregister alternative parameterizations for sensitivity analysis.
Limit claims to simulated-proxy conclusions and include explicit plans and constraints for future human-subject validation.
Provide mathematical/formal definition of explanation augmentation (format, length, content) and how it affects simulated acceptance probabilities.
Include wide sensitivity analyses over simulated-operator parameters and present Pareto frontiers with uncertainty bands to reflect calibration uncertainty.
Ensure reproducibility by publishing simulation code, seeds, and calibration scripts; document limitations prominently in manuscript.
